baja-bug.resumen: 3D design of the tubular chassis of a two-seat off-road vehicle and integration of its main components.
baja-bug.descripcion: CATIA V5 model of the tubular structure of an off-road buggy: roll cage, triangulated frame and mounting points. Seats, rear suspension with dampers, powertrain and wheels were integrated on the chassis to check clearances, ergonomics and assembly of the complete vehicle.

sobrealimentacion-vapor.resumen: Supercharging system for a four-stroke engine using steam generated from the engine coolant.
sobrealimentacion-vapor.descripcion:
Design of a forced-induction system for a four-cylinder, four-stroke engine that recovers heat from the cooling water: the coolant is turned into steam, and that steam drives the engine's supercharging.

I modeled the complete system integrated into the engine in CATIA V5: water and steam circuits, intake ducts, the boosting system and the radiator, paying attention to the routing of every line and the space available around the engine.

dron-vtol.resumen: First prototype of a fixed-wing drone designed for agricultural spraying.
dron-vtol.descripcion:
Design of a fixed-wing drone for agricultural spraying, intended to cover large crop areas with greater range than conventional multirotor drones.

This first prototype defines the overall aircraft configuration: wing, fuselage, tail boom, empennage and propulsion, modeled in CATIA V5.

prensa-carbono.titulo: Curing press for carbon fiber plates
prensa-carbono.resumen: Thermal sizing of a heated press for 500 × 500 mm carbon/epoxy plates, validated with finite volume simulation.
prensa-carbono.descripcion:
Thermal design of a press to cure carbon/epoxy composite plates (HexPly M79) of 500 × 500 mm and 20 to 100 mm thick, with the requirement of keeping temperature uniformity within 5 °C throughout the whole cure.

I calculated the required power with global energy balances, selected silicone heating blankets and thermal insulation, and developed two transient finite volume (FVM) models: an in-plane model to compare four heater layouts and a through-thickness model to verify that the core of the plate reaches process temperature, including the resin exotherm.

The multi-zone center–edge layout was the only one that met the criterion: it compensates perimeter losses without increasing total power. I also defined the control strategy (feed-forward + proportional) and the complete thermal cycle.

barra-estabilizadora.resumen: Design of an anti-roll bar for a Turismo Carretera race car, verified with finite element analysis and validated with hand calculations.
barra-estabilizadora.descripcion:
Design of the anti-roll bar of a Turismo Carretera race car: geometry of the torsion bar, arms and supports.

I analyzed its behavior with the finite element method (Von Mises stresses and deformations under service loads) and identified the critical areas at the joint between the bar and the arms.

I validated the simulation results with hand calculations of torsion and bending, to verify that the numerical model was correct before making design decisions.

fsae-itba.titulo: Formula SAE ITBA — Design and manufacturing
fsae-itba.resumen: Took part in the design and construction of the transmission and pedal box, developed the cockpit mockup and manufactured components for the ITBA Formula SAE car.
fsae-itba.descripcion:
I have been a member of the ITBA Formula SAE team since 2023, an interdisciplinary student team that designs, builds and runs a single-seater race car.

Transmission: I took part in the design and construction of the car's transmission, a chain drive that delivers the power of the electric motors to the wheels, and in its integration into the chassis.

Pedal box: I took part in the design of the pedal assembly and its mounting on the chassis.

Cockpit: I developed and built a full-scale mockup to define the cockpit of the new car, which allows testing driving positions with different drivers before freezing the final chassis geometry.

Other engineering tasks: I contributed to other design activities of the team, CAD modeling of components and the preparation of technical drawings for manufacturing.

Manufacturing: I took part in building the car, TIG and MIG welding and machining parts on the lathe and milling machine; I also have basic CNC knowledge.

di-meglio.resumen: Engineering Department Assistant at a Turismo Carretera racing team: CAD, finite elements, testing, dampers and data acquisition.
di-meglio.descripcion:
During 2023 I worked as an assistant in the Engineering Department of Di Meglio Motorsport, a Turismo Carretera racing team, both in the workshop and at race weekends.

Design and analysis: I carried out CAD modeling and finite element analysis of different car components.

Stiffness testing: I took part in measuring the torsional stiffness of a car's chassis and of an anti-roll bar.

Dampers: I worked on cycling Baratec racing dampers on the damper dyno and on their maintenance.

Data acquisition: I installed MoTeC data acquisition systems on Turismo Carretera and Turismo Nacional cars and analyzed the data logged on track. I also analyzed data from the AiM Solo system to help drivers better understand their performance on each lap and in each sector of the circuit.
